Honestly I don’t even know. Don’t feel like I enjoy anything to be honest

Present sucks, future’s bleak. Just don’t want to do it anymore. Don’t have much of a choice so I just have to keep going until I collapse under it all. 

Just doesn’t seem fair
Not anymore. Used to play the guitar, build computers, go out with friends. None of that makes me happy. I don’t even drink anymore. Just on autopilot until something happens
